**Construction Management** is a Bachelor of Technology degree-completion program focused on management, technical, and interpersonal skills for construction projects.

- **School:** School of Construction and the Environment  
- **Format:** Full-time or part-time, in person  
- **Campus:** Burnaby  
- **Curriculum:** Construction controls, organizational management, stakeholder engagement, management electives, Liberal Studies, and professional standards  
- **Sample courses:** **CMGT 7190 – Construction Planning and Controls**, **CMGT 7330 – Finance for Construction Managers**, **CMGT 7535 – Leadership and Interpersonal Skills**, and **CMGT 8700 – Industry Based Project Proposal**
- **Electives:** At least 4 credits from the approved management-elective pool
- **Liberal Studies:** 12 credits total
- **Final project:** After **CMGT 8700 – Industry Based Project Proposal**, students choose either **CMGT 8800 – Industry Based Project** or **CMGT 8810 – Industry Based Project**, subject to department approval.

Admission requires English Studies 12 at 73% or equivalent, a departmental pre-entry assessment, and one of four qualifying education/trade and work-experience pathways.

[Construction Management program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/)
